reason: Forbids a legal set when data_valid_i=0, the exact condition required for independent seed loading.
Forbids set when data_valid_i=1, although simultaneous set and data valid is legal and set has priority.
Under set_crc_i=1, equality with set_crc_i reduces to requiring data_valid_i=1; same legal-input restriction as slot_01.
Under set_crc_i=1, inequality with set_crc_i reduces to requiring data_valid_i=0; same legal-input restriction as slot_02.
Requires the next crc_out_o vector to be nonzero rather than equal to the sampled crc_in_i; a legal zero seed fails and many wrong nonzero results pass.
Constrains next-cycle data_valid_i after set, which is unconstrained and does not test the CRC seed load.
Constrains next-cycle data_valid_i to equal next-cycle set_crc_i; neither signal proves the prior seed load.
Requires a positive-edge pulse whenever d_i is high, including sustained high cycles with no edge; misses falling transition when d_i=0.
Requires positive-edge pulse low whenever negative-edge pulse is low; rejects a valid rising edge and is vacuous at the faulty falling edge when negative pulse is high.
With d_i true, equality q_posedge_pulse_o==d_i reduces to slot_01 and misses the falling transition.
With d_i true, inequality requires q_posedge_pulse_o=0 even on a valid rise; misses falling transition.
Requires next-cycle positive-edge pulse after any high d_i, including stable high; does not constrain pulse at falling transition.

A high d_i followed by a falling transition makes the next positive-edge pulse false in correct RTL and true in buggy RTL, so this can detect the targeted defect. It is broader than the repair condition and omits an explicit falling-edge antecedent.
After a high d_i, a next-cycle fall gives next d_i=0; correct positive pulse=0 passes while buggy pulse=1 fails. But stable high gives d_i=1 and pulse=0, a false failure in correct RTL.
